website_content.title: UPSC CMS Result 2026 Out: Combined Medical Services Examination Written Result Declared
website_content.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the written examination results for the Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE) 2026. Shortlisted candidates are now eligible for the Interview/Personality Test stage.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC CMS Result 2026 Overview
The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** has officially declared the results for the Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE) 2026. This result is based on the written examination conducted on **August 2, 2026**.

## Key Examination Dates
* **Written Exam Date:** August 2, 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Application Window:** March 11, 2026, to March 31, 2026

## Vacancy Details
A total of **1,358 vacancies** were notified for the roles of **Medical Officer** and **Assistant Medical Officer**. These positions are distributed across various prestigious government bodies, including:
* Indian Railways
* Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)
* New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC)

## Next Steps for Qualified Candidates
Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF must complete the following actions **within 15 days** of the result declaration:
1. **Portal Login:** Access the UPSC online portal.
2. **Update Details:** Refresh your educational qualification details.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload all necessary proof of eligibility.

## Required Documents for Interview/Verification
While the official call letter will provide the final checklist, candidates should prepare:
* **MBBS Degree** certificate and mark sheets
* **Medical Registration** (Permanent or Provisional)
* **Date of Birth Proof** (10th Certificate)
* **Category Certificates** (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
* **Photo ID** and recent passport-size photographs

website_content.title: GATE 2027 Registration Open - Apply via GOAPS Portal
website_content.summary: IIT Madras has opened the application window for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027. Eligible candidates can apply online through the GOAPS portal until September 27, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GATE 2027 Overview
The **Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027** is being conducted by **IIT Madras** on behalf of the National Coordination Board-GATE, Ministry of Education. This exam is the gateway for M.Tech/Ph.D. admissions and recruitment in various Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** August 27, 2026
* **Regular Registration Deadline:** September 27, 2026
* **Extended Registration (with Late Fee):** October 5, 2026
* **Application Correction Window:** October 14 to October 21, 2026
* **Exam City Allotment:** January 4, 2027
* **Exam Dates:** February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, and 21, 2027

## 💰 Application Fee
| Category | Regular Fee | Extended Fee |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Female / SC / ST / PwD | ₹1,000 per paper | ₹1,500 per paper |
| General / OBC-NCL / EWS | ₹2,000 per paper | ₹2,500 per paper |

## 🛠️ Key Requirements & Instructions
* **DigiLocker Mandatory:** A verified DigiLocker account is compulsory for all Indian national applicants.
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT) with a duration of 3 hours.
* **Facial Recognition:** New facial recognition systems are expected for registration and verification.
* **Paper Selection:** Candidates can opt for one or two approved test paper combinations.

## 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official GOAPS portal.
2. Ensure your **DigiLocker account** is linked and verified.
3. Register to generate an Enrolment ID and Password.
4. Fill in academic and personal details.
5. Select the test paper and preferred exam cities.
6. Upload required documents (Photo/Signature).
7. Pay the fee and submit the application.

website_content.summary: RPSC has released the Main Merit List (After Interview) for the Assistant Professor (Medical Education) Exam 2024 across five super-speciality subjects. Candidates can now verify their final merit rankings and selection status on the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RPSC Assistant Professor (Medical Education) Result 2026

The **Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC)**, Ajmer has officially published the **Main Merit List (After Interview)** for the post of Assistant Professor (Medical Education), Exam 2024. The results are discipline-specific for 33 total posts.

**Key Result Details:**
* **Post Name:** Assistant Professor (Medical Education)
* **Merit List Type:** Main Merit List (Post-Interview)
* **Total Vacancies:** 33
* **Page Designation:** PG-1

**Subjects Covered in this Release:**
* Nephrology
* Neurology
* Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
* Neuro Surgery
* Surgical Gastroenterology

**Important Dates (Merit List Release):**
* **Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery:** 01/09/2026
* **All Other Subjects:** 02/09/2026

**How to Check Your Result:**
1. Visit the official RPSC website.
2. Navigate to the **'Results'** section on the homepage.
3. Locate the link: **'Main Merit List (After Intv) for the post of Asst. Prof. (Medical Edu.) Exam 2024'**.
4. Open the PDF corresponding to your discipline.
5. Use your **Roll Number** to locate your name and final score.

**Understanding the PDF Columns:**
* **S.No. & Merit Number:** Your rank within the specific discipline.
* **Category:** GE (General), BC (Backward Class), SC (Scheduled Caste), ST (Scheduled Tribe), EWS (Economically Weaker Section).
* **Marks:** Includes Written Marks, Interview Marks, and the Grand Total.

website_content.title: MDU Rohtak Mercy Chance / Special Chance Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak has released the admit cards for the Mercy Chance/Special Chance 2026 scheme. Eligible students seeking to clear pending examinations can now download their hall tickets for the September 2026 exams.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak provides the **Mercy Chance/Special Chance** scheme to allow eligible students an additional opportunity to clear their pending examinations and complete their degrees.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15 May 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 July 2026 (Extended)
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Examination Date:** September 2026 (Exact dates to be confirmed)

## Fee Structure (Course-Wise)
Fees vary based on the chance number (1st, 2nd, or 3rd):

* **General Courses (BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, Diploma):** ₹15,000 to ₹21,000
* **Professional Courses (MBA, LLB, MCA, B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Ed):** ₹20,000 to ₹27,000
* **Integrated Courses (5/6 Year):** ₹15,000 to ₹27,000

## How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official admit card portal.
2. Enter your **Student ID/No** or **Registration Number**.
3. Submit the details to view your Reappear Admit Card.
4. Verify all details (Name, Roll No, Center) and print the document.

## Crucial Instructions for Candidates
* **Identity Proof:** Candidates must carry a valid **original photo ID** to the exam center.
* **Practical Exams:** Report to the **practical exam center**, not the theory center mentioned by default on the admit card.
* **Payment Issues:** If the fee status shows "Un-Paid" despite payment, email `[email protected]` with payment details.
* **Eligibility Issues:** If status shows "Not Eligible (NE)", visit the Result Branch at Pariksha Sadan, MDU Rohtak, at least 3 days before the exam.

website_content.title: BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) is inviting online applications for 14 Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE) positions in Kochi. Eligible B.E/B.Tech graduates must apply by 23rd September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a PSU under the Ministry of Defence, is recruiting for **Deputy Engineer E-II (FTE)** on a Fixed Tenure Basis (Initial 5 years, extendable up to 2 years).

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Electronics:** 6 Posts
* **Computer Science:** 5 Posts
* **Mechanical:** 3 Posts
* **Total:** 14 Vacancies

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Full-time **B.E/B.Tech** degree in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-approved college/university.
* **Class Requirement:** 
    * UR/EWS/OBC: First Class
    * SC/ST/PwBD: Pass Class
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **28 years** as of 01 September 2026.

## Salary & Perks
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 40,000 - 3% - Rs. 1,40,000
* **Benefits:** Dearness Allowance, HRA, 35% basic pay perquisites, Performance Related Pay (PRP), Group Insurance, Medical facilities, and PF.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 23 September 2026

## Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on application and documents.
2. **Written Test:** 85 Marks.
3. **Interview:** Shortlisted candidates in a 1:5 ratio.

## Application Fee
* **Gen/EWS/OBC:** Rs. 400 + 18% GST
* **SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM:** No Fee

website_content.title: TG TET Hall Ticket 2026 for In-Service Teachers
website_content.summary: The Department of School Education, Government of Telangana, has released the hall tickets for the TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026. Candidates can now download their admit cards for the CBT exam scheduled from September 7 to 11, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Overview
The **Telangana Teacher Eligibility Test (TG TET)** for In-Service Teachers is now open for hall ticket downloads. This examination is mandatory for teachers currently working in Government, Local Body, and other specified institutions in Telangana.

## Key Exam Information
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Papers:** 
    * **Paper I:** For Classes I–V
    * **Paper II:** For Classes VI–VIII
* **Purpose:** This qualification is valid **only for continuation in service or promotion**. It cannot be used for direct recruitment.

## Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release:** September 2, 2026
* **Examination Window:** September 7, 2026, to September 11, 2026
* **Result Declaration:** Between September 28 and September 30, 2026

## Download Requirements
To access the hall ticket, candidates must provide the following details:
* 12-digit **Aadhaar Number**
* **Journal Number** (from application/fee payment)
* Registered **Mobile Number**
* **Date of Birth** (DD/MM/YYYY)

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Centre
* Printed copy of the **TG TET Hall Ticket 2026**
* Original valid **Photo ID Proof**
* Any other documents mentioned in the official Information Bulletin

website_content.title: SSC JE Recruitment 2026 - Junior Engineer & Scientific Assistant
website_content.summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) invites online applications for 1748 tentative vacancies for Junior Engineer and Scientific Assistant posts. The deadline to apply is September 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026. This recruitment covers multiple technical roles across various Central Government organizations, including the India Meteorological Department (IMD).

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 1748 (Tentative)
* **Post Category:** Group 'B', Level-6
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Posts Offered
* **Junior Engineer (Civil)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical & Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Telecom)**
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD)**

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 02.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 22.09.2026 (23:00 hrs)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 23.09.2026
* **Correction Window:** 28.09.2026 to 30.09.2026
* **Paper-I Exam (Tentative):** October/November 2026
* **Paper-II Exam (Tentative):** December 2026

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **JE (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical):** Degree or Diploma in the respective engineering discipline from a recognized institute.
* **JE (Telecom):** Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology (Electrical, Electronics, CS, IT, etc.).
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD):** Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics or relevant Engineering degree.

### Age Limit (as of 01.08.2026)
* **General:** Up to 30 or 32 years (depending on the organization).
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

## Selection Process
1. **Paper-I (CBE):** Qualifying exam covering Reasoning, General Awareness, and Technical subjects.
2. **Paper-II (CBE):** In-depth technical subject examination.
3. **Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates.
4. **Medical/Physical Standards:** Applicable for specific posts (e.g., BRO/GREF).

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS (Male):** ₹100
* **Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM:** Exempted

website_content.summary: MCC has opened Round 2 counselling for MBBS, BDS, and other UG medical courses. Registration and choice filling began on September 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has officially opened the **NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling** registration. This round is critical for candidates who did not secure a seat in Round 1 or those seeking to upgrade their currently allotted seat.

## Courses and Institutions
Admission is available for **MBBS, BDS**, and other participating undergraduate medical courses across:
* 15% All India Quota (AIQ)
* Central Universities
* AIIMS & JIPMER
* ESIC institutes
* Deemed Universities

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Starts** | September 3, 2026 |
| **Registration & Fee Payment Closes** | September 8, 2026 |
| **Choice Filling Window** | September 3 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Choice Locking Window** | September 8 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 11, 2026 |

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Portal Access:** Visit the official MCC website.
2. **Registration:** Use 'New Registration' for first-timers or log in with existing Round 1 credentials.
3. **Details:** Enter personal, educational, and category information.
4. **Payment:** Complete the online registration fee payment.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Review and lock your choices before the deadline to ensure they are considered.

## Key Candidate Instructions
* **Strict Deadlines:** MCC generally does not extend registration or choice-locking windows.
* **Verification:** Double-check college names, fee structures, and bond obligations before locking.
* **Security:** Never share your login credentials with third-party agents.

* **Sub Inspector (SAF):** 69
* **Sub Inspector (Technical - Arms/Photo/QD/Finger Print):** 45

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Subedar / SI (SAF/DEF):** Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* **SI (Arms):** 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **SI (Photo/QD/Finger Print):** Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.

### Age Limit (as of 23.09.2026)
* **Male (UR):** 33 Years
* **Male/Female (Reserved/MP Domicile):** 38 Years
* **Female (MP Domicile):** 38 Years
* **Special Relaxations:** Up to 43 years for specific categories (inter-caste marriage/Vikram Award winners).

## Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Written Exam:** Objective type (100 Marks).
2. **Main Written Exam:** Two to three compulsory papers (600-900 Marks).
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** 800m race, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
4. **Interview:** Final stage (50 Marks).

## Salary & Benefits
**Pay Level 9:** ₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800. Candidates undergo a 3-year probation with a graded stipend (70%, 80%, and 90% of minimum pay).

website_content.title: ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Date & Schedule
website_content.summary: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) has announced the examination dates for the CA Foundation September 2026 session. The exams are scheduled to take place on September 2, 5, 7, and 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Overview
The **Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)** has released the official schedule for the CA Foundation September 2026 session. Candidates must ensure they have completed their registration within the stipulated deadlines to be eligible for the admit card.

## 📅 Key Exam Dates
* **Paper 1: Principles and Practice of Accounting** - September 2, 2026
* **Paper 2: Business Laws and BCR** - September 5, 2026
* **Paper 3: Business Mathematics, LR & Statistics** - September 7, 2026
* **Paper 4: Business Economics and BCK** - September 9, 2026

## ⏰ Exam Timings
* **Reporting Time:** 1:30 PM
* **Exam Start Time:** 2:00 PM
* **Duration:** 
    * Papers 1 & 2: 3 Hours (Ends at 5:00 PM)
    * Papers 3 & 4: 2 Hours (Ends at 4:00 PM)

## 🗓️ Important Application Timeline
* **Online Application Start:** July 6, 2026
* **Deadline (Without Late Fee):** July 19, 2026
* **Deadline (With Late Fee of ₹600):** July 22, 2026
* **Correction Window:** July 23 to July 25, 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** Expected last week of August 2026

## 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official ICAI exam portal.
2. Log in via the **Self Service Portal (SSP)** credentials.
3. Select the relevant CA Foundation exam form.
4. Enter required details and pay the applicable fee.
5. Submit the form and download the confirmation page.

## ⚠️ Important Instructions
* The **correction window** is available only once; verify all details carefully.
* A **valid admit card** is mandatory for entry into the exam center.
* Only candidates who successfully submit the exam form will receive admit cards.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **State CET Cell, Maharashtra** is set to publish the final merit list for candidates seeking admission into the four-year **B.Pharmacy** and six-year **Pharm.D** courses. This list is the definitive ranking used for the CAP Round 1 seat allotment process.

1. Visit the official CAP portal.
2. Locate and click the **Final Merit List** link in the notifications section.

4. Verify your State Merit Number, Category, and Candidate Type (MS/AI).
5. Download and print the final merit status slip for admission purposes.

* **Verification:** Carefully cross-check your **Category** and **Candidate Type** before filling the option form.
* **Preparation:** Review the seat matrix released on September 4 before starting the web option filling process on September 5.

website_content.title: AP EdCET Counselling 2026: B.Ed Admission Process
website_content.summary: Registration for B.Ed course admissions in Andhra Pradesh is expected to begin in September 2026. Qualified candidates can participate in the online counselling process for seat allotment.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
AP EdCET counselling is conducted for candidates seeking admission into **B.Ed courses** across Andhra Pradesh. The process is entirely online, encompassing registration, verification, and seat allocation.

## Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must have qualified for the AP EdCET exam.
* A **minimum score of 40 marks** is required to be eligible for counselling.

## Counselling Process Stages
1. **Online Registration:** Initial sign-up and fee payment.
2. **Document Verification:** Uploading and verifying scanned certificates.
3. **Web Options Entry:** Choosing preferred colleges and courses.
4. **Seat Allotment:** Allocation of seats based on rank and preference.
5. **Self-Reporting:** Confirming admission at the allotted college.

## Important Dates (Expected)
* **Phase 1 Registration:** September 2026
* **Phase 2 Registration:** September 2026
* **Spot Admission Process:** October 2026
* **Closing of Portal:** October 2026

## Required Documents for Upload
* AP EdCET Rank Card & Allotment Letter
* Class 10th and 12th (10+2) Mark Sheets
* Income Certificate & Caste Certificate
* Migration Certificate & Transfer Certificate
* Aadhaar Card

## How to Apply
* Visit the official portal and click on **'Candidate Registration'**.
* Log in using your **Date of Birth** and **Hall Ticket Number**.
* Fill in academic details and upload scanned documents.
* Pay the processing fee online to finalize the application.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
EdCIL (India) Limited, a Mini Ratna Category-I CPSE, is recruiting technical manpower on a contractual basis for the newly established **Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)** at the Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) Headquarters, New Delhi. This unit will oversee the execution of infrastructure and construction projects nationwide.

| Post Name | Vacancies |

| Architect | 1 |
| Senior Engineer (Civil) | 1 |
| Engineer (Civil) | 2 |
| Junior Engineer (Civil) | 6 |
| AutoCAD/Revit Operator | 1 |
| Young Professional (Data Mgmt) | 2 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Nationality:** Indian Nationals only.
* **Cut-off Date:** Qualifications and experience must be acquired by **31.07.2026**.

### Post-wise Requirements:
* **Architect:** B.Arch + 10 years experience in institutional building design.
* **Sr. Engineer (Civil):** B.Tech/B.E Civil + 10 years experience in construction supervision.
* **Engineer (Civil):** B.Tech/B.E Civil + 7 years experience in building construction.
* **Junior Engineer (Civil):** Diploma/B.Tech Civil + 1-3 years experience.
* **AutoCAD/Revit Operator:** Diploma Civil/ITI Drafting + 2 years BIM/3D experience.
* **Young Professional:** B.Tech (CS/IT)/BCA/B.Sc (IT) + 2 years MIS/Data Analytics experience.

## Remuneration (Consolidated Monthly)
* **Architect / Sr. Engineer:** ₹80,000 – ₹1,00,000
* **Engineer (Civil):** ₹60,000 – ₹80,000
* **JE / AutoCAD Op / Young Professional:** ₹35,000 – ₹40,000

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02-09-2026
* **Application Start Date:** 02-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Application Fee:** Nil

## Selection Process
Selection is based on professional qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates may be called for an **Interview** via email.

website_content.title: South Eastern Railway (SER) Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: RRC South Eastern Railway invites applications for 10 vacancies in Level-1 and Level-2 categories under the Scouts & Guides Quota. Applications are open from September 7 to October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
South Eastern Railway (SER) has released the official notification for recruitment under the **Scouts & Guides Quota for 2026-27**. This is a specialized recruitment for candidates who possess both the required educational qualifications and mandatory Scouts & Guides certifications.

## Vacancy Details
* **Level-2 (Group C):** 02 Posts
* **Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D):** 08 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 10

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **For Level-2:** 12th (+2 stage) with minimum 50% marks OR 10th Pass with NAC/ITI approved by NCVT.
* **For Level-1:** 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent qualification (NAC granted by NCVT).

### Mandatory Scouts & Guides Qualification
Candidates **must** fulfill the following to be eligible:
* Must be a **President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger** OR a **Himalayan Wood Badge (HWB)** holder.
* Minimum **5 years** of active membership in the Scouts Organization.
* Participation in at least **two National Level/All India Railway events** and **two State Level events**.

## Age Limit (As of 01-01-2027)
* **Level-2 (Group C):** 18 to 30 Years
* **Level-1 (Group D):** 18 to 33 Years
*(Age relaxation applies as per government norms)*

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500 (Refundable ₹400 after written test)
* **SC/ST/ESM/PwBD/Women/Minority/EBC:** ₹250 (Refundable ₹250 after written test)

## Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 60 Marks (40 Objective + 20 Essay) focusing on Scouts & Guides and GK.
2. **Certificate Evaluation:** 40 Marks based on achievements.
3. **Document Verification**
4. **Medical Examination**

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 01 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06 October 2026

website_content.title: NCL PM Internship Scheme Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) invites online applications for 73 Intern positions under Round 3 of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for FY 2026-27.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a Miniratna PSU and subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is offering **73 internship vacancies** across various disciplines under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for the financial year 2026-27.

## Vacancy Details
The vacancies are distributed across the following trade/discipline combinations:

* **Foreman (Electrical):** 17 Posts (Diploma in Electrical)
* **Foreman (Mechanical):** 16 Posts (Diploma in Mechanical)
* **Lab Technician:** 13 Posts (B.Sc in Chemistry)
* **Clerk:** 9 Posts (Bachelor of Commerce)
* **Pharmacist:** 9 Posts (Diploma in Pharmacy)
* **Overseer:** 9 Posts (Diploma in Civil)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (as of 01-04-2026).
* **Education:** Candidates must hold the relevant diploma or degree from a recognized institute/university as specified in the trade list.

## Internship Benefits & Terms
* **Stipend:** ₹9,000 per month (credited to Aadhaar-linked bank account).
* **Duration:** 9 months from the date of engagement.
* **Selection Process:** Based on the merit list (aggregate percentage scores of the qualifying examination in descending order).
* **Nature of Engagement:** This is a training internship and does **not** lead to regular employment with NCL or Coal India Limited.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 01-09-2026
* **Crucial Date for Eligibility:** 01-04-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06-09-2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Bank of India (BOI), a premier Public Sector Bank, has announced vacancies for **Officers in various Specialist streams**. The recruitment covers positions from Scale I (Officer) up to Scale IV (Chief Manager).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 01.08.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 10.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 25.09.2026
* **Age/Qualification Cut-off Date:** 01.08.2026

Total Vacancies: **205** across 48 distinct roles.

* **Scale IV (Chief Manager):** 10 Posts (Age: 28-42)
* **Scale III (Senior Manager):** 49 Posts (Age: 28-40)
* **Scale II (Manager):** 118 Posts (Age: 25-35)
* **Scale I (Officer):** 28 Posts (Age: 21-30)

* **IT & Digital:** Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Info Security, DevSecOps, Data Engineering, Database Administration, and API Governance.
* **Professional Services:** Law Officers, Fire Officers, Security Officers, and Civil Engineers.

## Job Location
Postings will be **anywhere in India**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Non-Collegiate Women's Education Board (NCWEB), Delhi University, has announced the **5th cut-off list** for admissions into BA (Programme) and B.Com courses for the 2026-27 session.

## Important Dates
* **Cut-off List Released:** 31 August 2026
* **Admission Window Opens:** 1 September 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Admission Window Closes:** 2 September 2026 (11:59 PM)

## Course & Eligibility Highlights
* **Courses Covered:** BA (Programme) and B.Com
* **Target Audience:** Female candidates who have not yet secured admission.

    * **Highest B.Com Cut-offs:** Hansraj College and Miranda House (~79% for OBC/EWS).

## How to Apply
1. Visit the official NCWEB admission portal.
2. Log in using registered credentials.
3. Verify if your marks meet the 5th cut-off for your category and desired subject at the specific teaching centre.
4. Select the eligible teaching centre and subject combination.
5. Submit your choice within the window (1st Sept to 2nd Sept).
6. Complete verification and fee payment as directed.

## Important Instructions
* Admissions are processed strictly at the respective teaching centres.
* Colleges marked with an asterisk (*) hold classes on Saturdays; others hold them on Sundays.
* Candidates are advised to re-verify the official PDF for less common subject combinations.

website_content.title: Mathura Anganwadi Helper (Sahayika) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Office of the District Programme Officer, Mathura (ICDS) has released a notification for 544 honorarium-based Anganwadi Helper posts. Eligible women candidates must apply online by September 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Mathura Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 provides a significant opportunity for women residents of Mathura to contribute to the Child Development Project (ICDS). A total of **544 vacancies** are available across various rural and urban zones.

## Key Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only women candidates are eligible to apply.
* **Residence:** Candidates **must** be residents of the same Ward/Gram Sabha where the vacancy exists.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 01, 2026).

## Educational Qualification
* **Minimum Requirement:** Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent.
* **Merit Calculation:** The merit list will be prepared based on educational qualifications ranging from Intermediate up to Postgraduate levels.

## Selection Process
Selection is based strictly on a **Merit List** derived from educational qualifications. No written exam or interview is required. 

**Priority categories include:**
* BPL Category candidates
* Widows
* Destitute/Abandoned women

website_content.title: Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 3 Fresh Option Entry
website_content.summary: KEA has opened fresh option entry for Round 3 seat allotment for UGCET 2026 across various professional courses. Eligible candidates must submit their choices between August 31 and September 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has announced the commencement of **Round 3 (Fresh Option Entry)** for UGCET 2026. This is a critical opportunity for candidates who have not yet secured a seat or wish to participate again after surrendering a previous allotment.

## Courses Covered
Candidates can fill options for the following professional courses:
* **Engineering** (B.E./B.Tech)
* **Architecture** (B.Arch)
* **Agriculture** and allied Farm Sciences
* **Pharmacy** (B.Pharm)
* **Nursing** and other allied health courses

## Important Dates
* **Round 3 Option Entry Opens:** August 31, 2026
* **Last Date to Fill/Lock Options:** September 3, 2026

## Who is Eligible?
* Candidates who did **not** receive a seat in Round 1 or Round 2.
* Candidates who surrendered their previously allotted seat (as per KEA rules).
* Candidates who selected **Choice 2** (retain and participate) in Round 2.

## Crucial Rule: Choice Selection
Unlike earlier rounds, Round 3 has restricted choices. **Only Choice 1 (Accept & Freeze)** is available. Candidates cannot select Choice 2 or Choice 3 in this round.

## Step-by-Step Process to Fill Options
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **CET application number** and credentials.
3. Review the updated **Round 3 seat matrix**.
4. Enter preferred college and course combinations in order of priority.
5. **Lock your options** before the deadline; only the final submitted list is considered.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra is conducting the Centralised Admission Process (CAP) 2026 for admission into various professional undergraduate programmes across participating colleges in Maharashtra.

## Courses Covered
* **BBA** (Bachelor of Business Administration)
* **BMS** (Bachelor of Management Studies)
* **BCA** (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
* **BBM** (Bachelor of Business Management)
* **Integrated MBA** (First year of the four-year course)

## Important Dates for Round 4
* **Vacant Seats Displayed:** August 29, 2026
* **Allotment List Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Overall CAP Window Closing:** September 8, 2026

## Eligibility for Round 4 Participation
* Candidates who did not accept any seat allotted in Rounds 1, 2, or 3.
* Candidates who accepted a seat previously but selected the **'Betterment'** option.

## Key Instructions
* **Betterment Option:** Once a seat is accepted without choosing 'betterment', the candidate exits the CAP pool.
* **Institute Level Round:** Any seats remaining vacant after Round 4 will be transferred to the Institute Level admission round for direct filling by colleges.
* **Documentation:** Keep your Application ID and password secure for all subsequent login requirements.

website_content.title: COMEDK UGET 2026 Round 4 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: COMEDK has released the final regular counselling round (Round 4) seat allotment results for UGET 2026. Allotted candidates must complete fee payment by September 3 and report to colleges by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Consortium of Medical, Engineering and Dental Colleges of Karnataka (COMEDK)** has announced the Round 4 seat allotment results for UGET 2026. This marks the **final regular counselling round** of the current cycle, aimed at filling 17,815 vacant engineering seats across 151 colleges.

## Key Dates
* **Allotment Result Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Decision-Making & Fee Payment:** September 1, 2026 (4:00 PM) to September 3, 2026 (2:00 PM)
* **College Reporting Deadline:** September 8, 2026 (3:00 PM)

## Allotment Status Options
* **Accept and Freeze:** Available for candidates receiving an allotment for the first time or those whose status automatically converted from 'Upgrade' in Round 3.
* **Reject and Withdraw:** Available for candidates receiving an allotment for the first time.
* **Refund:** Candidates who chose 'Reject and Upgrade' in Round 3 but received no allotment in Round 4 will exit the process and receive a refund.

## Important Rules & Penalties
* **Finality:** Round 4 is the last regular round; no seat cancellation options are available hereafter.
* **Forfeiture:** Candidates who fail to report to their allotted college will **forfeit the entire tuition and other fees** paid to COMEDK.
* **Financial Penalty:** An additional penalty of **five times the fee amount** may be applied for non-reporting after acceptance.

## How to Check Result
1. Visit the official website.
2. Click on the **Round 4 seat allotment result** link.
3. Log in with your application number and password.
4. Download the allotment letter for reporting purposes.

website_content.markdown_content:
## TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts Recruitment 2026

The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has released Notification No. 8/2026 for the **Combined Technical Services Examination (CTSE) - Interview Posts**. This is a premium opportunity for technical professionals to join various Government departments and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) in Tamil Nadu.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 170 Posts
* **Total Post Types:** 31 Different Designations
* **Selection Process:** Written Examination (Paper I & Paper II) followed by an Interview.
* **Application Mode:** Online Only

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 31.08.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 07.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 06.10.2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Correction Window:** 10.10.2026 to 12.10.2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Qualifications
Since there are 31 different posts, eligibility varies. Key requirements include:
* **Engineering/Tech:** B.E/B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, CSE, IT, ECE, Textile, etc.) for roles like Assistant Manager and Senior Officer.
* **Finance/Accounts:** CA/ICWA/MBA (Finance) for Assistant General Manager (Finance) and Accounts Officer.
* **Veterinary/Medical:** B.V.Sc or M.V.Sc for Veterinary Assistant Surgeon and Research Assistant.
* **Specialized:** Masters in Psychology, Library Science, Statistics, or Traditional Architecture for respective roles.
* **Experience:** Certain senior roles (Unit Head, AGM) require 5 to 20 years of relevant industry experience.

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancy Breakdown (Major Posts)
* **Veterinary Assistant Surgeon:** 79
* **Senior Officer (Technical):** 10
* **Senior Entomologist:** 13
* **English/Tamil Reporters:** 11
* **Assistant Manager (Various):** 9
* **Other Specialist Posts:** 50+ distributed across 20+ roles

### 💰 Salary
Selected candidates will be placed according to the **TN Govt Pay Matrix Levels** (ranging from Level 27 to Level 30 depending on the post).

website_content.title: CONCOR Recruitment 2026: Apply for Management Trainee & Assistant Officer
website_content.summary: CONCOR (Navratna CPSE) is hiring 77 professionals for Management Trainee and Assistant Officer roles across various disciplines. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Overview
Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR), a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, has released employment notification 05/2026 for direct recruitment of technical and administrative professionals.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 31 August 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Application Last Date:** 30 September 2026 (11:55 PM)
* **Eligibility Reckoning Date:** 31 August 2026

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **77**
* **Management Trainee (MT):** 45 Posts (Commercial, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil, Personnel & Admin)
* **Assistant Officer (AO):** 32 Posts (Commercial, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**1. Management Trainee (Age: 18–28 Years)**
* **MT/CO:** Graduate (55%) + MBA/PG Degree in Marketing/Logistics/Supply Chain (60%)
* **MT/FA:** Graduate (55%) + Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
* **MT/FA/CS:** Graduate (55%) + Qualified Company Secretary (CS)
* **MT/TH:** B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics (60%)
* **MT/MIS:** B.Tech/BE (CS/IT) or MCA/M.Sc(IT) (60%)
* **MT/CE:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (60%)
* **MT/P&A:** Graduate (55%) + MBA/MSW in HRM/Personnel Management (60%)

**2. Assistant Officer (Age: 18–32 Years)**
* **AO/CO:** Graduate (50%) + 4 years experience (reduced to 2 years with specific diplomas)
* **AO/FA:** B.Com (50%) + 4 years experience (reduced to 2 years for CA/CMA Inter)
* **AO/TH:** Diploma/Degree in Mech/Elec/Electronics (50%) + relevant experience
* **AO/MIS:** Graduate with PGDCA/BCA/B.Sc CS (50%) + relevant experience
* **AO/CE:** B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil (50%) + relevant experience

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Management Trainee:** Pay Scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 | **Approx CTC: ₹20.11 Lakhs p.a.**
* **Assistant Officer:** Pay Scale ₹40,000-1,36,000 | **Approx CTC: ₹16.09 Lakhs p.a.**
* *Note: MTs are absorbed into Assistant Manager grade (E1) after 1 year of training.*

### ⚙️ Selection Process
* **Management Trainee:** CBT $ightarrow$ Group Discussion (GD) and/or Interview
* **Assistant Officer:** Selection purely based on **CBT performance** (No GD/Interview)

**CBT Pattern:** 100 Questions | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes | Negative Marking: 0.25

### 💳 Application Fee
* **MT Posts:** ₹750 + GST (UR/OBC/EWS) | SC/ST/PwBD/ESM: Exempted
* **AO Posts:** ₹500 + GST (UR/OBC/EWS) | SC/ST/PwBD/ESM: Exempted

website_content.title: PSSSB Assistant District Attorney (ADA) Final Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: PSSSB has released the final answer keys for the Assistant District Attorney (ADA) written exam held on August 2, 2026. Candidates can now download set-wise PDFs for Advt. No. 09 of 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## PSSSB ADA Final Answer Key 2026

The **Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (PSSSB)** has officially published the final answer keys for the **Assistant District Attorney (ADA)** recruitment (Advt. No. 09 of 2026) for the Department of Justice, Government of Punjab.

**Exam Overview:**
* **Post Name:** Assistant District Attorney (ADA)
* **Written Exam Date:** 02 August 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 31 August 2026
* **Sets Released:** Set A, Set B, Set C, and Set D

## Important Dates
* **Written Examination:** 02/08/2026
* **Final Answer Key Release:** 31/08/2026

## How to Download the Final Answer Key
1. Visit the official PSSSB portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Keys'** or **'Notices'** section on the homepage.
3. Locate the link for **'Final answer key of Written Examination'** for Assistant District Attorney (Advt. No. 09 of 2026).
4. Select the PDF corresponding to your exam set (**Set A, B, C, or D**) as mentioned on your admit card.
5. Save the PDF and cross-verify your responses.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Verify Set:** Ensure you are checking the key for your specific question booklet set; keys are not interchangeable.
* **Final Status:** This is the post-objection final key; no further objection window is currently mentioned.
* **Official Source:** Only trust PDFs downloaded from the official board website.

website_content.summary: The Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd. is inviting offline applications for 19 contract-based banking positions. Eligible candidates must apply by September 15, 2026, for various roles across its multi-state branches.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Panipat Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd. (Multi State Bank) has announced vacancies for several professional roles on a **contract basis**. These positions will be stationed across Kaithal, Jagadhari, Yamunanagar, Panchkula, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, and other proposed branches.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Educational Qualification | Experience Required |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Senior Accountant** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 7 Years in Banking |
| **Junior Accountant** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 5 Years in Banking |
| **Senior Clerk** | 3 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/MBA (Finance & Marketing) | Min. 2 Years in Banking |
| **Clerk-cum-Cashier/Field Supervisor** | 10 | B.Com/BBA/BCA/B.Tech/B.E (CSE/IT)/M.Com/MBA | As applicable |

## Key Highlights
* **Application Fee:** Nil (Free of cost)
* **Selection Process:** Personal Interview, Assessment, or Written Test based on bank requirements.
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Handwritten application in a sealed envelope).

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 15 September 2026 (up to 5:00 p.m.)

## Documents Required
* Handwritten Application Form
* Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* Educational Certificates (Photocopies)
* Experience Certificates (Photocopies)
* Copy of Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
* Latest passport-size coloured photograph

## How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official careers page.
2. Fill the form in your **own handwriting** (Typed applications will be rejected).
3. Attach all required documents and a recent photograph.
4. Seal the envelope and superscribe the post applied for on top.
5. Send it via post/courier or submit in person to: **The Managing Director, The Panipat Urban Co-Operative Bank Ltd., 3rd City Centre, #932-935/8, GT Road, Panipat, Haryana (132103)**.

website_content.title: Southern Railway Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Southern Railway (SR) is inviting online applications for 4,471 Act Apprentice positions for Freshers and Ex-ITI candidates. The application window closes on September 27, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Southern Railway (SR), through the Office of the Chief Workshop Manager, Carriage & Wagon Works, Perambur, has released Notification No. 01/2026 for the engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. This is a **training engagement** and not a guarantee of permanent employment.

## Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **4,471**
* **Fresher Category:** 163 posts (Fitter, Welder, Painter, MLT)
* **Ex-ITI Category:** 4,308 posts (Various trades across multiple divisions/workshops)

## Eligibility Criteria
**Geographical Jurisdiction:** Candidates must reside in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala, Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep Islands, SPSR Nellore & Chittoor (Andhra Pradesh), or Dakshina Kannada (Karnataka).

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Fresher (Fitter, Painter, Welder):** 10th Class with minimum 50% aggregate.
* **Fresher (MLT):** 12th Class (PCB) with minimum 50% aggregate.
* **Ex-ITI:** 10th Class (min 50%) + ITI certificate in relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT.
* *Note: 50% minimum mark requirement is relaxed for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.*

## Age Limit (As of 28-08-2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 15 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 22 Years (General) / 24 Years (MLT)
* **Age Relaxation:** OBC (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), PwBD (10 years).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 28-08-2026
* **Application Start Date:** 28-08-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 27-09-2026 (till 17:00 Hrs)
* **Tentative Shortlist Publication:** 15-10-2026

## Stipend & Application Fee
* **Stipend:** ₹8,200 (10th Std) to ₹9,600 (12th Std/ITI) per month. Incremental increases apply in the 2nd and 3rd years.
* **Application Fee:** ₹100 (Non-refundable). Exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/Women.

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a **Merit List** prepared by converting Matriculation and ITI marks into a 200-point scale.

website_content.title: Gujarat NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: ACPUGMEC has opened Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS admissions under the Gujarat state quota for eligible NEET UG 2026 candidates.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Educational Courses (ACPUGMEC), Gandhinagar, has commenced the **Round 2 Registration** process for MBBS and BDS admissions. This round is specifically designed for candidates seeking seats under the Gujarat state quota (85%).

## Eligibility Criteria
Round 2 is open to the following categories of NEET UG 2026 qualified candidates:
* **New Applicants:** Candidates who did not participate/register in Round 1.
* **Round 1 Participants:** Candidates who registered in Round 1 but were not allotted a seat.
* **Non-Freezers:** Candidates who were allotted a seat in Round 1 but chose not to freeze or accept it.

## Important Dates
* **Round 2 Registration Start Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Other Dates:** Please monitor the official portal for the provisional merit list, choice filling, and seat allotment schedules.

## How to Register
1. **PIN Purchase:** Visit the official portal and purchase a registration PIN (skip if you already have one from Round 1).
2. **Online Application:** Log in using your PIN and NEET UG/Class 12 details to fill in personal and domicile information.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload all required academic and category documents.
4. **Verification Slot:** Select a preferred Help Centre and a time slot for in-person document verification.
5. **Physical Verification:** Visit the designated Help Centre with original documents to collect the signed Registration Acknowledgement Slip.

## Key Instructions
* **Mandatory Verification:** Online registration alone is not sufficient; in-person document verification is compulsory for participation.
* **Choice Filling:** Candidates must complete the choice filling process in every round to be considered for seat allotment.
* **Security:** Keep your PIN and password confidential until the entire admission and refund process is complete.

website_content.title: UP Board Exam 2027 Registration Update (Class 10 & 12)
website_content.summary: UPMSP has extended the registration deadlines for students appearing in the 2027 High School and Intermediate board examinations. Schools must now complete fee deposits and data uploads by the revised September deadlines.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP)** has announced an extension for the registration process for the academic session 2026-27. This extension provides affiliated schools additional time to manage fee collection, treasury deposits, and student data verification.

## Revised Registration Schedule 2027
| Activity | Revised Deadline |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Fee Collection from Students** | September 1, 2026 |
| **Deposit Fee in Treasury** | September 5, 2026 |
| **Data Upload & Correction Window** | September 6 to September 11, 2026 |
| **Final Submission to DIOS Office** | September 30, 2026 |

## Eligibility Criteria
Registration is mandatory for the following categories:
* **Regular Students**: Currently enrolled in Class 10 or 12 in UPMSP-affiliated schools.
* **Private Candidates**: Those meeting the specific board eligibility guidelines.
* **Compartment/Improvement Candidates**: As permitted by the board rules.

## School-Level Registration Process
1. **Fee Collection**: Schools collect exam fees from students.
2. **Treasury Deposit**: The head of the institution deposits fees via challan.
3. **Data Upload**: Academic details and challan info are uploaded to the official portal.
4. **Verification & Correction**: Principals verify data; corrections are made during the window (ending Sept 11).
5. **DIOS Submission**: Final lists and documents are submitted to the District Inspector of Schools.

## Important Instructions
* **Mandatory Process**: Only registered students will receive admit cards.
* **Accuracy**: No corrections will be accepted after the window closes.
* **Student Role**: Students must confirm with their respective schools that their details (Name, DOB, Subjects) are uploaded correctly.

The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, has announced direct recruitment for **60 vacancies**. The positions are spread across PGIMER Chandigarh (Group C) and the PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur (Group A, B, and C).

* **Animal Attendant:** 1 Post

* **Computer Programmer (Group B):** 1 Post

website_content.title: DNH & DD AYUSH Recruitment 2026: Apply for 30 Medical & Technical Posts
website_content.summary: The DMHS, U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu is recruiting for 30 short-term contract positions under the National AYUSH Mission. Eligible candidates across India can apply by September 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## DNH & DD AYUSH Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Directorate of Medical & Health Services (DMHS), U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has announced vacancies for the **100-bedded Ayurvedic Hospital at Pati, Silvassa**. These positions are on a short-term contract basis under the National AYUSH Mission.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Vacancies | Monthly Remuneration |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Senior Medical Officer** | 1 | Rs. 1,06,966/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Senior)** | 9 | Rs. 37,500/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Medium)** | 9 | Rs. 31,250/- |
| **Panchakarma Technician (Junior)** | 10 | Rs. 25,000/- |
| **Yoga Instructor** | 1 | Rs. 28,000/- |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

*   **Senior Medical Officer:** BAMS with MD/MS in specialized fields (Panchakarma, Shalya Tantra, etc.) + Minimum 5 years experience (10 years desirable).
*   **Panchakarma Technicians:** Diploma/Certificate in Panchakarma. Experience required based on level (Senior: 10 yrs, Medium: 5 yrs, Junior: None specified).
*   **Yoga Instructor:** Diploma in Yoga Science (D.Y.Sc.) or Diploma in Yoga Therapy (DYT).

### ⚙️ Selection Process
*   **No Written Exam:** Selection is based **solely on an interview**.
*   **Shortlisting:** Candidates will be screened based on their applications and notified via email/telephone 7 days prior to the interview.

### 📅 Important Dates
*   **Advertisement Date:** 29 August 2026
*   **Application Deadline:** 12 September 2026

### 📝 How to Apply
1.  Download the prescribed application format from the official website.
2.  Attach self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates.
3.  Submit the completed application via **Hard Copy** to the Office of the Mission Director, Silvassa, or via **Email** to the official recruitment address.
4.  Ensure the application reaches the authority by **12 September 2026**.

## WB NEET UG 2026 Round 1 Allotment Overview

The West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) has officially announced the **Round 1 Seat Allotment Result** for candidates seeking admission to MBBS and BDS courses under the state quota in government and private medical/dental colleges of West Bengal.

* **Result Release Date:** August 31, 2026

Allotted candidates must physically report to their assigned college between **September 1 and September 5, 2026**. Please ensure you carry:

website_content.title: ICAR-NRC Banana Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: ICAR-NRC Banana invites online applications for 20 Graduate and Technician Apprentice positions for the 2026 session. Eligible candidates must apply via the NATS portal by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
ICAR – National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB) is offering a one-year training opportunity under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973. This is a merit-based selection process for fresh graduates and diploma holders.

## Vacancy Details
**Total Posts: 20**

* **Graduate Apprentices (18 Posts):**
    * B.Sc (Life Science): 6 Posts
    * B.Sc (Agriculture/Horticulture): 4 Posts
    * B.Sc (Biotechnology/Botany/BCA/Computer Science): 2 Posts each
    * B.Sc (Biochemistry/Chemistry): 1 Post each
* **Technician Apprentices (2 Posts):**
    * Diploma (Agriculture/Horticulture): 2 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university/institute.
* **Passing Year:** Must have passed in **2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026**.
* **Experience:** Candidates with 1 year or more of work experience or those who have already completed an apprenticeship are **NOT eligible**.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Must be registered on the **NATS Portal**.

## Stipend
* **Graduate Apprentices:** ₹12,300 per month
* **Technician Apprentices:** ₹10,900 per month

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Purely based on **Merit** (Aggregate marks of the qualifying degree/diploma).
* **Verification:** Shortlisted candidates will be called for certificate verification at the Tiruchirappalli center.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 27 August 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 17 September 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## UPCATET Round 3 Seat Allotment Overview

The **UPCATET Round 3 Seat Allotment** is the critical third stage of the counselling process for the Uttar Pradesh Combined Agriculture and Technology Entrance Test 2026. This offline round is designed to fill the remaining vacant seats after the first two rounds of allotment.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Banda University of Agriculture and Technology (BUAT), Banda
* **Mode of Round 3:** Offline (Includes in-person document verification)
* **Result Date:** August 30, 2026
* **Purpose:** Allocation of seats left vacant due to withdrawals, upgrades, or non-reporting.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **UPCATET UG Exam:** June 17, 2026
* **UPCATET PG Exam:** June 18, 2026
* **Round 1 Result:** July 26, 2026
* **Round 2 Result:** August 8, 2026
* **Round 3 Result:** August 30, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Status
1. Visit the official counselling dashboard.
2. Click on the **Round 3 Seat Allotment/Result** link.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/DOB**.
4. View your allotted university, programme, and category.
5. Download and print the **Provisional Allotment Letter**.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Failure to report to the allotted university within the deadline will lead to automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Offline Verification:** Since this is an offline round, ensure all original documents and a printed copy of the allotment letter are ready before visiting the campus.
* **Further Rounds:** Candidates not allotted a seat in Round 3 should monitor the portal for potential spot or special rounds.

website_content.title: Karnataka High Court District Judge (LDCE) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Karnataka has announced 79 vacancies for District Judge via Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This internal promotion is open exclusively to eligible serving Senior Civil Judges by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Karnataka is inviting applications for the post of **District Judge** through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) as per Rule 4-B of the Karnataka Judicial Service (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2025. 

**Important Note:** This is an internal promotional recruitment and is **NOT open to the general public**.

## Key Recruitment Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 79 (Subject to Supreme Court ruling in WP(C) No. 1022/1989)
* **Post Name:** District Judge (25% LDCE Category)
* **Selection Process:** Written Examination followed by a Viva-voce
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must be serving Senior Civil Judges and satisfy the following as of 28.08.2026:
* **Service as SCJ:** Minimum 3 years of service as a Senior Civil Judge.
* **Total Service:** Minimum 7 years of combined service in the cadre of Civil Judge and Senior Civil Judge.
* **Age:** Minimum 35 years of age.
* **Attempts:** A maximum of 3 attempts are allowed for this LDCE.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 28 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026, 11:59 PM
* **Eligibility Reckoning Date:** 28 August 2026

## Application Process
1. Visit the official portal at `judiciary.karnataka.gov.in`.
2. Complete the online application form with a valid mobile number and email ID.
3. Upload a recent passport-size photo (White background, max 50KB, JPG).
4. Upload a signature (Black ballpoint pen on white paper, max 25KB, JPG).
5. Submit the application before the deadline.

website_content.title: DRDO NPOL Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NPOL, a laboratory of DRDO, is inviting eligible candidates for the position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) across seven disciplines. Selection will be conducted via a walk-in interview on 10 October 2026 in Kochi.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (NPOL)**, under the **Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO)**, Ministry of Defence, has announced recruitment for **Junior Research Fellows (JRF)**. This is a prestigious opportunity to contribute to defence research in various technical disciplines.

## Vacancy Details
Vacancies are distributed across seven disciplines. While Mechanical Engineering has confirmed seats, others are listed as anticipated based on requirements:
* **Mechanical Engineering:** 04 Vacancies
* **Computer Science & Engineering:** Anticipated
* **Chemical/Rubber/Polymer/Nanotechnology/Materials Science:** Anticipated
* **Opto Electronics:** Anticipated
* **Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering:** Anticipated
* **Physics:** Anticipated
* **Oceanography/Ocean Technology/Meteorology:** Anticipated

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **Engineering Streams:** 1st Division B.E/B.Tech with valid GATE OR 1st Division M.E/M.Tech.
    * **Basic Sciences:** 1st Division Post Graduate degree with valid NET/GATE.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **28 years** as of the date of the walk-in interview.
* **Other:** Candidates with foreign degrees must provide an equivalence certificate from AIU, Delhi.

## Fellowship & Duration
* **Stipend:** ₹37,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per rules.
* **Tenure:** Initially for **2 years**, extendable based on performance and rules.

## Selection Process
Selection is based entirely on a **Walk-in Interview**. No separate online application is required. 

## Important Date & Venue
* **Interview Date:** 10 October 2026 (Saturday)
* **Reporting Time:** 09:30 hrs
* **Venue:** Bhavan's Varuna Vidyalaya, NPOL Campus, Thrikkakara P.O., Kochi, Kerala – 682021.

website_content.title: UKSSSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UKSSSC is recruiting for 553 Group C posts across various government departments in Uttarakhand. Eligible candidates with a 12th-pass qualification can apply online by October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UKSSSC Group C Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has announced direct recruitment for **553 vacancies** in Group 'C' posts. This is a massive opportunity for candidates seeking stable government employment in Uttarakhand.

### 📌 Key Vacancies
* **Administrative Roles:** Junior Assistant, Senior Assistant, Computer Assistant, Registration Clerk.
* **Technical Roles:** Computer Operator, Telephone Operator, Assistant Mineral Supervisor.
* **Field Roles:** Survey Lekhpal, Land Acquisition Amin/Inspector.
* **Others:** Store Keeper, Grihamata, Ahalmad & Cashier.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Intermediate (Class 12) or equivalent from a recognized board.
* **Typing Skill:** Minimum Hindi typing speed of **4000 KDPH** on a computer is mandatory for most posts.
* **Special Requirements:** Some posts require MS Office knowledge or specific diplomas (e.g., Computer Operator, Store Keeper).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 08 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 07 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 12 October to 14 October 2026
* **Written Exam Date:** 15 November 2026 (Tentative)

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026)
* **General Range:** 18 to 42 years.
* **Specific Posts:** Minimum 21 years for certain Junior Assistant and Store Keeper roles.
* **Relaxation:** 5 years for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and 10 years for PwBD candidates.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR / OBC:** ₹300
* **SC / ST / EWS / PwBD:** ₹150
* **Orphan Candidates:** Exempted (₹0)

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Written Exam:** 100 Objective questions (100 marks) covering Hindi, General Knowledge, and Uttarakhand GK. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
2. **Typing Test:** Qualifying stage for those who clear the written exam.

website_content.summary: RPSC has released the admit cards for the Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO) Preliminary Examination for 371 vacancies. The examination is scheduled to be conducted on 2nd September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RPSC APO Preliminary Examination 2026

The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has officially released the hall tickets for the **Assistant Prosecution Officer (Sahayak Abhiyojan Adhikari)** Preliminary Examination. Candidates who applied under Advertisement No. 03/EXAM/APO/EP-I/2026-27 can now access their admit cards.

**Key Examination Details:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 371 Posts
* **Exam Mode:** Offline (Pen and Paper Based)
* **Prelims Exam Date:** 2 September 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** 27 December 2026

**Important Dates Timeline:**
* **Notification Release:** 27 May 2026
* **Application Window:** 08 June 2026 to 07 July 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 30 August 2026

**How to Download Your Admit Card:**
1. Visit the official RPSC portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Admit Card'** section on the homepage.
3. Select the link for **'Asst. Prosecution Officer – 2026 (Pre)'**.
4. Enter your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Enter the CAPTCHA and click submit to download your PDF.

**Mandatory Documents for Exam Day:**
* **Printed Admit Card:** A clear printout of the downloaded hall ticket.
* **Photo ID Proof:** Original Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving Licence, or Passport.
* **Photographs:** Two recent passport-size photographs (same as uploaded in the application).
* **Certificates:** Disability or Category certificates (if applicable).

website_content.summary: The Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB) has announced the final results for the Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services 2026. Candidates for Constable, Fireman, and Special Tiger Guard positions can now verify their selection status.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APSSB Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026 Final Result

The Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB), Itanagar, has released the **Final Result Notice** (Notice No. APSSB-13/6/2026/1342) for the Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026.

### 📌 Posts Covered
The final result includes provisional recommendations for the following positions:
* **Special Tiger Guard** (under STPF)
* **Fireman**
* **Constable** (Indian Reserve Battalion - IRBn)
* **Constable Band** (IRBn)
* **Constable Civil Police** (Male & Female)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Advertisement Issued:** 13.03.2026
* **Provisional Result:** 20.06.2026
* **Document Verification:** 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026
* **PST, PET & Trade Test:** 13.07.2026 to 26.07.2026
* **Medical Fitness Test:** Started from 10.08.2026
* **Final Result Declaration:** 01.09.2026

### 🛠️ Selection Process
The final selection has been determined based on the **Merit-cum-preference** of candidates who successfully completed the following stages:
1. Document Verification (DV)
2. Physical Standard Test (PST)
3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
4. Trade Test
5. Medical Fitness Test

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Provisional Nature:** This result is a provisional recommendation and does not guarantee a final appointment.
* **Verification:** Final appointment is subject to independent verification of character, antecedents, and eligibility by the Appointing Authority.
* **Joining Details:** Specific joining dates and reporting locations have not been mentioned; candidates must monitor the official website for further communication from the Home, STPF, or Forest Departments.
